title: Deep clean
_comment: Everything past dev caches. Nothing here is pre-selected. 'rest': true makes a catch-all category skip every path another rule already names (same path, inside it, or containing it), so ~/Library/Caches/* never double-counts. 'exclude' lists basename globs to leave out. 'perItem': true shows one row per matched path, so each backup / emulator image is picked on its own. 'minAgeDays' on a path rule keeps only matches with nothing inside modified for that many days. kind 'simulators' and 'brew' run a fixed command the script hard-codes. kind 'files' lists the user's own large, long-unused files: the script, not this file, decides they only ever go to the Trash, only from non-hidden folders of $HOME outside Library, and are never pre-selected or picked by 'a' / -y.

categories.name: Other app caches
categories.desc: Every other folder in ~/Library/Caches that no specific rule names — apps rebuild them. Quit apps first. Apple's own system caches are left alone.

categories.name: Other app logs
categories.desc: Every other folder/file in ~/Library/Logs no specific rule names — old log output, never read back by apps.

categories.name: Saved window state
categories.desc: Per-app window restore data (~/Library/Saved Application State). Apps just reopen with fresh windows.

categories.name: Mail attachment cache
categories.desc: Copies of attachments Mail saved when you opened them — the originals stay in the mail. Needs Full Disk Access to be seen.

categories.name: iPhone/iPad backup
categories.desc: A local Finder/iTunes device backup. Moved to the Trash (recoverable). Keep the latest one of any device you still use.

categories.name: iOS/macOS firmware (.ipsw)
categories.desc: Restore images Finder/Configurator downloaded — fetched again if you ever restore a device.

categories.name: Dead iOS simulators
categories.desc: Simulators whose iOS runtime is gone (Xcode moved past it) — they can never boot again. Removed with 'xcrun simctl delete unavailable'.

categories.name: Android system image
categories.desc: An emulator system image in the Android SDK — re-downloadable from SDK Manager.

categories.name: Android emulator (AVD)
categories.desc: An Android Virtual Device and its data. Moved to the Trash (recoverable); delete its leftover entry in Device Manager afterwards.

categories.name: Kotlin/Native toolchain
categories.desc: A Kotlin/Native compiler or its LLVM/sysroot dependencies in ~/.konan — re-downloaded by the next KMP build that needs that version. Keep the one your projects use now.

categories.name: Old Maestro test runs
categories.desc: Logs and screenshots of Maestro test runs in ~/.maestro/tests untouched for 30+ days — debug output, never read back by Maestro.

categories.name: Stale shein worktree
categories.desc: A shein order worktree with nothing modified for 30+ days. Moved to the Trash (recoverable); run 'git worktree prune' in its repo afterwards.

categories.name: Homebrew old versions
categories.desc: Outdated formula/cask versions and stale downloads Homebrew keeps around. Removed with 'brew cleanup --prune=all'.

categories.name: Old installers in Downloads
categories.desc: Disk images and installer packages in ~/Downloads untouched for 30+ days — usually already installed. Moved to the Trash (recoverable). Archives (.zip, ...) are not listed here: those are often your own data.
